transcript:
SFX the wind slams the door again. The wind picks up; soon lots of doors are banging. 

DAVID (CONT’D) (Speaking above the howling wind): It would be as if the wind is actually this asylum’s...

Suddenly all the doors slam at once, and never bang again. The wind dies down in an instant, almost hearing what David said.

DAVID (CONT’D) (Shocked at the silence): ...ghost...

The wind is almost gone. We hear David breathing.

DAVID (CONT’D): I...  (Slightly nervous) Okay, this place just managed to unnerve me... For... For those at home, all the doors just slammed shut at once. Not one is left open. The wind is also gone. I... Damn...

MARTIN: You okay? 

DAVID: Yeah... That was...

One of the doors at the end of the hallway opens. We hear the creak of the door far away.

DAVID (CONT’D) (Quietly): OK, one of the doors just opened on its own. That was... pretty damn creepy.
